verdict.rationale: Sentry documents rule-based alerting (Alerts, Ownership Rules, Fingerprint Rules) plus integrations (Slack, PagerDuty, Webhooks) that let users define conditions on events to automatically trigger notifications/actions, which is the core of this automation story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the rule engine's reliability and AI-native-specific usage (e.g., programmatic rule creation via MCP/API) beyond generic docs listings.
